title: Fan-in of a selected output circuit
statement: Let $C$ be a multi-output Boolean DAG circuit with $n$ input vertices, and suppose every gate reads at most two distinct vertices and every NOT gate reads exactly one vertex. For any valid output index $i$, the single-output circuit obtained by selecting the $i$th output has the same property: every gate reads at most two distinct vertices, and every NOT gate reads exactly one vertex.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a multi-output DAG circuit with $n$ input vertices
Every gate's argument list has no repetitions
Every NOT gate has exactly one argument
Every gate has at most two arguments
$i$ is less than the number of outputs of $C$
